subject: general
question: According to Fleming's right-hand rule, the index finger and the central finger of the right hand represent directions of ______ and ______, respectively.

options.text: motion of the conductor, induced current
motion of the conductor, magnetic field

solution:
• According to Fleming's right-hand rule, the forefinger is pointed in the direction of Magnetic Field.
 
• The thumb is pointed in the direction of the motion of the conductor related to the Magnetic Field while the second finger represents the direction of the induced or generated current.
 
• Fleming's Right-hand Rule gives the direction of induced current when a conductor moves inside a Magnetic Field.
